Because DoD runs plain cargo test, this target stops scripts/definition-of-done.sh --fast for every dispatch on this repo.

- Fails identically on a direct rerun of the single target in a clean extraction of 07dbbcb5 (exit=101), and equally on 62bf8df3 (beadrs-5ccd39a2 test-only commit) — independent of that change.
- Not a monolith-default sweep leg: not in beadrs-a8019498's leg list; the failure surface (dry-run ok, real redaction refuses) suggests triage in the redaction selection path or its scanner-ruleset interaction (cf. R038/BR-T42 work), not checkpoint layout.

Proposal only: root cause not diagnosed. Labels proposal-pending + human pending admission.

issue.description:
ADR-005 records the limitation that there is no way to mark an assignment as intentionally held, so an operator who legitimately parks work under an assignee gets the assignment warning on every doctor run and learns to ignore it, which degrades the check for everyone. Spec an opt-in reservation marker: set and cleared only via public CLI, recorded in the audit trail, documented in the field guide (`bead schema explain`) and help; make the doctor ready_frontier check skip deliberately-held assignments; preserve the diagnose-don't-mutate posture (nothing auto-clears, ever). Keep the semantics distinct from the existing manual_blocked flag so the two frontier exclusions stay explainable, and cover the new state in checkpoint round-trip and conformance tests. Depends on the ready_frontier check existing; block this bead on it.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
